annotations.text:
Chosen direction (2026-09-11): Engineering ledger.
Table-first and calm: sidebar with counts, one-line state, metrics as a 4-row table, attention / changes / matrix / perf as ledgers with hairline dividers and left status rails. Healthy is neutral; only problems carry color. DM Sans + JetBrains Mono, 30 px rows, graphite palette.
The Cockpit CSS tokens and MiniJinja templates are built against this board.
A · Instrument panel — not chosen. Kept for reference: the segmented state bar, mono readouts and 20-run strips may still be borrowed for the Feature Detail and Tests pages.
C · Briefing — not chosen. Kept for reference: the one-sentence verdict and the prose 'why' cards inform the Overview headline and the Feature Detail 'Why?' chain.
